body:
A note from the research in `docs/research/heidenhain/` (merged with #4099), for the dwell choice in this PR. This is a plain comment, not a review.

The PR writes `FUNCTION DWELL TIME` in DIN/ISO programs for TNC 640 from 34059x-07 and for a machine with no controller identity (`supportsFunctionDwell()`, and test cases 4 and 5).

- HEIDENHAIN's change lists add `FUNCTION DWELL` to the **Klartext** language at TNC 640 34059x-07, TNC 620 81760x-04, TNC 320 77185x-04 and TNC7. We found no source that confirms the same function in an **ISO** program for any version. See `dialects.md`, the `dwell` flag: "ISO always uses `G04 F..` (cycle 9); `FUNCTION DWELL` in an ISO program is not confirmed for any version", and the `FUNCTION DWELL` row in `differences.md` (sources 1322095-02 p65, 1322094-03 p48, 819494-24 p14).
- `G04 F<seconds>` (cycle 9 DWELL TIME) is in the DIN/ISO manuals of every control that has DIN/ISO, the newer ones included.

Suggestion: write `G04 F` for every DIN/ISO dwell, and keep `FUNCTION DWELL` for the Klartext post (where the version check applies). This also removes the risk for a machine with no identity, where the control is unknown.

If you have a DIN/ISO manual page that shows `FUNCTION DWELL` in an ISO program, please add the reference. Then the version check is the right rule, and `dialects.md` must be corrected.

Note: #4094 (the G200/G205 parameter set for iTNC 530 340 49x) is in work on a separate branch. It keeps away from the dwell lines, so the two PRs merge without a conflict.

Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4158, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Needs changes before merge.** Review tier: SAFETY (the PR changes posted G-code of the Heidenhain DIN/ISO post).

### What is good

- The iTNC 530 case is correct. The Fehlmann Picomax 55 file (iTNC 530, NC 340490-03) now posts `G04 F0.5*` and no `FUNCTION DWELL`. This closes the main point of #4093.
- The pinning test `heidenhain_dwell_writes_g04_f_for_itnc_and_function_dwell_for_newer` is in the correct crate and suite. It asserts the two forms on five machines.
- No recorded program changes. No golden `.nc`, `.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file contains a dwell block, and the example catalog suites stay green.
- Body: `Fixes #4093` and a `Changelog:` line are present. No process file is changed.

### Results (locally, trial merge of c2baa58 with upstream/main 12ea01a)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only "post suites"`: 76 steps, 0 failed (`heidenhain_block_form` 6/6, `heidenhain_cycles` 11/11, `script_heidenhain`, `script_heidenhain_klartext`, `cycle_dwell`, `ream_cycle`, `bore_cycle` and the other post suites of the plan).
- `camcraft-app` suites that post through this script, by name: `example_catalog` (43 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `conformance` (7), `bore_cycle`, `drill_rplane`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `post_spindle_rule_all`, `tapping_mode`, `probe_op`, `first_part_programs`, `golden_cl` (34). All passed.
- The other app suites of the quick plan (they match only the word "heidenhain") were not run.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane: not run. Heavy lanes: not needed (P3).

Extra suites run: the example catalog suites above. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or importer code.

Mutations (each was restored after the run):

1. `if (supportsFunctionDwell())` changed to `if (true)`: `heidenhain_dwell_writes_g04_f_for_itnc_and_function_dwell_for_newer` fails at `heidenhain_block_form.rs:320`. RED, as expected.
2. The space removed from `"FUNCTION DWELL TIME "`: the pinning test fails at `heidenhain_block_form.rs:351`, and `nonzero_entry_peck_and_deep_and_backbore_keep_the_expanded_chain` fails at `heidenhain_cycles.rs:373`. RED, as expected.

### Requested before merge

**1. BLOCKER: an identity that the rule does not recognise gets `FUNCTION DWELL`** (`assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:821-822` and `:842`).

`supportsFunctionDwell()` returns `true` when the model has no match and the NC string does not match `^(\d{5})\d-(\d{2})`. The machine file accepts any non-empty `nc_software` string (`crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs:18-28`). I ran a probe test with the ream stream of the pinning test:

```
TNC 640 / 340 590-06   -> N100 FUNCTION DWELL TIME 0.5*   (the PR's own table says G04 F)
TNC 426 / unknown      -> N100 FUNCTION DWELL TIME 0.5*
iTNC530 / unknown      -> N100 FUNCTION DWELL TIME 0.5*   (no space in the model name)
TNC 640 / 340595-06    -> N100 G04 F0.5*
```

HEIDENHAIN prints NC numbers with a space ("340 590-06"). Thus a correct machine file can get the block that the control refuses. The control stops with an alarm. This is the defect of #4093 again, for the controls that the rule does not know.

Class: the default is the unsafe form. Close the whole class with one rule, not with more patterns:

- Recommended (the suggestion of the earlier research comment on this PR): write `G04 F<s>` for every DIN/ISO dwell. `docs/research/heidenhain/dialects.md:57`, `:122` and `:155` say that `FUNCTION DWELL` in an ISO program is not confirmed for any version. `docs/research/heidenhain/cycles.md:54` says that cycle 9 (`G04`) is on all contouring controls.
- Alternative: an allow-list. Write `FUNCTION DWELL` only when the model and the parsed version match a row that has an ISO source. Any other identity, and no identity, gets `G04 F`.

With either rule, case 5 of the pinning test (no identity) must change to `G04 F`. Add a test case for a spaced NC string and for an unknown model.

**2. The source of the new block form is not given** (`assets/posts/heidenhain.cps:826-831`, `crates/post/tests/heidenhain_block_form.rs:9`).

- The PR changes `FUNCTION DWELL TIME0.5` to `FUNCTION DWELL TIME 0.5` for each machine that keeps the function. The issue asks to check the syntax in the manual. The PR body and the script give no manual page for the space.
- The version table in the script names no document. The table comes from the Klartext "new functions" lists (1322095-02 p65, 1322094-03 p48, 819494-24 p14), not from an ISO manual.
- The header of `heidenhain_block_form.rs:9` still cites 892909-25 p. 456 as `FUNCTION DWELL TIME<seconds>`. That ISO manual is from 9/2016, which is before 34059x-07. If that page shows the function in an ISO program, then the `-07` limit is also wrong. If it does not, then the citation is wrong.

Fix: if you keep `FUNCTION DWELL` in any case, name the ISO manual page in the script and in the test header. If you take the recommendation of item 1, remove the stale citation and keep `G04 F` as the one form.

### Notes (not blocking)

- The PR is a draft. After the fix, please run the pinning tests and `heidenhain_cycles` again, and mark the PR ready (`gh pr ready 4158`) for a new review.
- I did not change the draft state or the labels of this PR.

Adopted the review recommendation: removed FUNCTION DWELL from the DIN/ISO post and emitted G04 F<s> unconditionally for all DIN/ISO dwells. Updated heidenhain_block_form.rs and heidenhain_cycles.rs to assert G04 F across all controllers, software versions, spaced NC strings, unknown models, and default machine with no identity. Removed stale citation. Pinning tests and clippy pass cleanly.

**Result: passed.** `G04 F0.5` loads, reads back (the control writes it as `G4 F0.5`) and Test Runs to the program end with no alarm on the iTNC 530 station (606425-04). Not tested: `FUNCTION DWELL` in ISO on a TNC 640.

Station test of the `G04 F` dwell that this PR writes (head `9479d9faa`).

Station: iTNC 530 programming station, NC software `606425 004 SP20` (demo, 100-block limit). I did not build the PR. I made the program by hand from the post frame of `ream.nc` on main and the block that the pinning test `heidenhain_dwell_writes_g04_f_in_iso_for_all_controllers_and_defaults` expects (`G04 F0.5*`). I loaded the file as `TNC:\CC4158F1\VMC_3-AXIS.I`.

```
%VMC_3-AXIS G71 *
N10 ; OPERATION: Ream*
N20 ; T3 REAMER 8H7 - D8*
N30 T3 G17 S400*
N40 M3*
N50 M8*
N60 G00 G40 G90 Z+10*
N70 G00 X+10 Y+10*
N80 G00 X+10 Y+10 Z+2*
N90 G01 X+10 Y+10 Z-12 F150*
N100 G04 F0.5*
N110 G01 X+10 Y+10 Z+2 F150*
N120 G00 X+10 Y+10 Z+10*
N130 M9*
N140 M5*
N150 M2*
N99999999 %VMC_3-AXIS G71 *
```

SHA-256 of the file: `eed0b9882a0a4e81ae9077a3d31ff3fd842d0a3c47bb7b503019533563d705ad`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Load (ASCII to binary) | Yes. No `ERROR =` block. |
| Readback | 17 of 17 lines. 16 lines are identical. The control wrote `N100 G4 F0.5*` for `N100 G04 F0.5*`. Only the leading zero is different. |
| Test Run | Reached `STOP REASON: block END PGM or M02`. The log has no numbered alarm and no `ERROR SOURCE` line. |

Not verified:
- The graphics pane stayed blank and showed `ERROR`, as in the earlier station runs (the program has no `BLK FORM`). This test does not show the length of the dwell.
- The station is an iTNC 530. It cannot test `FUNCTION DWELL` in ISO on a TNC 640, and it does not show what a TNC 640 does with `G04 F`.

Review set merge-ready: clean review (post suites, clippy and heidenhain-adjacent suites green, example catalog suites green on the trial-merged tree, light lane twins run and passed by name) and mergeable with main. A maintainer approves and merges by hand.
